prayerExcerpt.en-US: Endeavor so to act as you would wish to have acted when you stand before your Judge.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Esforça-te por agir como desejarias ter agido quando estiveres diante do teu Juiz.

meta.face: A Florentine of about fifty, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a warm, light-olive complexion and a WIDE, SOFT, ROUND face, after the Renaissance portrait on his Wikipedia page — a small, LOW forehead under a THICK ring of grizzled dark hair in the tonsure (not bald), a LARGE, AQUILINE nose curving down to a HOOKED tip, SMALL, NARROW dark eyes that SLANT DOWN at the outer corners, softly pouched beneath, under thin, arched brows, FULL, soft cheeks and gentle jowls, a SMALL, pursed mouth, a soft, ROUND chin; the gaze lowered to the crucifix, contrite and tender. Not the square-jawed, keen-eyed albert_great, the domed, bald antoninus_florence, or any of the seven servite_founders.
meta.basis: No portrait from life is known; the Renaissance painting used on Wikipedia shows a round, fleshy face with a large nose, which the card follows. The crucifix held as a book is from the Martyrology ('considerava Cristo crocifisso l'unico suo libro'); the tiara from the book's refusal of the papacy.
